set.body: Phase 1 review finding 7 of 8. R/reliability.R .execute_guarded() catches ordinary errors but a synthetic interrupt escapes before cleanup runs, so resources and failure receipt state can be lost on a real user interrupt. Put cleanup and receipt finalization on an unconditional exit path while preserving interrupt semantics and reporter isolation. Specify precedence when computation, interrupt handling, cleanup, or reporting also fails. Done when interrupt, error, cleanup-error, and success tests prove exactly-once cleanup and truthful completion and cleanup status.
set.title: Run cleanup and receipt finalization on interrupts
